arxiv.title: Vocabulary-Free Next-Event Prediction on Temporal Graphs
arxiv.abstract: Autoregressive transformer training through next-token prediction has driven remarkable advances in language modeling and has become increasingly effective for time-series modeling. Yet its success in temporal graph learning remains limited, and most temporal link-prediction methods are discriminative rather than autoregressive. While temporal graphs can have a natural serialization through chronological ordering edges, they lack an obvious graph-independent tokenization: existing node tokenization often uses a vocabulary that grows with the number of nodes, limiting scalability and cross-graph training. We propose GTGT, Generative Temporal Graph Transformer, a simple yet powerful vocabulary-free framework for self-supervised next-event prediction on temporal graphs. It predicts events for observed destinations, behavioral descriptors for novel destinations, and time gaps before new event. These targets have shared meanings across graphs, allowing one transformer to train across disjoint node sets without node-specific learned parameters. Local node identifiers let attention capture graph structure: Theoretically, we can show that our transformer-based model has the capacity for time-respecting message passing mechanisms. On Temporal Graph Benchmark (TGB), our GTGT not only achieves comparable or better link-prediction performance than established baselines, but also has much lower training cost. These results open the door to temporal graph pretraining for forecasting and other downstream tasks, providing a concrete step toward temporal graph foundation models.

arxiv.title: Human Capital in Context: What Employment Survival Reveals About Worker-Firm Match
arxiv.abstract: There is no best worker in general, only a best worker for a particular firm. We develop a measure of worker-firm match quality that treats fit as a property of the pair, learned from the survival of employment relationships. A two-tower neural network embeds workers, from their career histories and current positions, and firms, from their characteristics and business descriptions, into a common space, and match quality is the cosine similarity of the two vectors. The measure takes its functional form from the skill-weights model of firm-specific human capital, and its only estimated objective, a separation hazard, from the view of the job match as an experience good. Estimated on more than a billion person-periods covering 101 million workers and 8.4 million firms, a 0.1 increase in match quality lowers the odds of separation by 48%. About a quarter of the variance of match quality is specific to the worker-firm pair, which worker-, firm-, and occupation-level measures set to zero by construction. Workers earn more when better matched, especially early in a relationship, and firms whose workforces score higher grow faster, become more profitable, and are issued more, and more valuable, patents over the next five years than their industry peers. Because it scores pairs that never formed, the measure also predicts where movers go, and acquirers record a larger share of the price as goodwill when the target's workers would fit the acquirer better than they fit the target.
arxiv.titleZh: 情境中的人力资本：就业存续揭示了员工—企业匹配的哪些信息

arxiv.title: Wayfinder: Adaptive Resource Routing from Agent Citations
arxiv.abstract: To act effectively, agents must gather contextual information across resources such as chats, issue trackers, email and knowledge bases, to answer questions like "what was decided in the last project meeting?" or "where is the FAQ for our internal tooling?" Where this information lives in a user's environment is unknown to the agent, so it re-explores the same resources across consecutive interactions. Common routing approaches represent each resource as a tool and rely on high-level descriptions to generalize to unseen environments. Such descriptions often fail to separate similar or overlapping resources and cannot improve from the agent's subsequent interactions. We introduce Wayfinder, an adaptive router that uses the documents cited by the downstream agent as feedback about where relevant information resides. These citations update Wayfinder's internal resource representations, which subsequent interactions use to prioritize the resources likely to contain relevant information. We also introduce resource augmentation during offline reinforcement learning, which anonymizes and permutes resource identities to discourage training-time overfitting of which resource holds which topic; our ablations suggest it helps most when few training environments are available. Because no openly available professional environments pair realistic queries with resource-access patterns, we construct and release three controlled testbeds derived from existing datasets: NFCorpus, FEVER and Tech Startup. Compared with supervised, tool-retrieval and contextual bandit baselines under a shared closed-loop protocol, Wayfinder gives the best routing when resources contain semantically overlapping content that static descriptions cannot distinguish, while description-based tool retrieval suffices when resources are drawn from distinct corpora.

arxiv.title: Human-Likeness and Conversational Preference Diverge for Synthesized Agent Speech in Customer-Service Calls
arxiv.abstract: Listeners can judge an agent's speech on how human it sounds (human-likeness) and on how much they would want to talk to it (conversational preference). Listening tests rarely ask about conversational preference, so the relation between the two judgments is unclear. We compared them in paired-choice tests on 120 turns that actors improvised as customer-service representatives. On each trial, two agents spoke the same turn. In Study 1, both agents came from six commercial text-to-speech systems, each with eight voices. In Study 2, one was the actor's original recording and the other a system. Some systems ranked higher on human-likeness, and others on conversational preference. Listeners chose systems over actors in 19% of human-likeness trials but 36% of conversational preference trials (and 49% for the most preferred system). On both judgments, variation among a system's voices was about three-quarters of that between systems. Of three automatic naturalness scores, two predicted lower human-likeness, and none predicted conversational preference. In this setting, listeners tended to favor faster speech and fewer pauses between clauses on both judgments, and more pitch variation for conversational preference. Thus, measuring only human-likeness or testing one voice per system can misjudge which agents listeners would rather talk to.

arxiv.title: Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation as an Optimization Constraint for Continual Learning
arxiv.abstract: Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) is a widely used regularization-based technique for continual learning, protecting performance on old tasks with a quadratic penalty whose empirical Fisher is usually justified through probabilistic curvature. We instead introduce Continual Learning as an Optimization Constraint (CLOC): new training must preserve chosen functionals of learned behavior. EWC's empirical Fisher is exactly the first-order form of this constraint when the preserved functional is each sample's loss. This derivation exposes a flaw: EWC implicitly weights each sample by the scale of its loss gradient, so well-fitted samples lose importance. EWC-DR observed this failure in classification; CLOC identifies its general cause. Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation (IEWC) penalizes output changes according to the first-order approximation of each old sample's loss level set, removing the weighting for any differentiable loss and output geometry, and prevents corrupt samples from dominating the importance matrix. Across classification, segmentation, language, forecasting, and diffusion, IEWC variants match or improve on EWC and outperform EWC-DR. In a held-out evaluation with validation-selected hyperparameters, uniform IEWC improves ImageNet-R accuracy over matched EWC by 2.00 percentage points (95% CI 0.93-3.07).

arxiv.summaryZh: 从优化约束的角度重新推导弹性权重巩固(EWC):把持续学习表述为「新训练必须保持已学行为的指定泛函」，而EWC的经验Fisher恰是以每样本损失为保留泛函时该约束的一阶形式。这一推导暴露了EWC的缺陷——它按损失梯度的尺度隐式给样本加权，拟合良好的样本反而丧失重要性。IEWC改为按旧样本损失水平集的一阶近似惩罚输出变化，对任意可微损失与输出几何都消除该加权，并抑制损坏样本主导重要性矩阵。在分类、分割、语言、预测与扩散任务上，IEWC各变体持平或优于EWC并超过EWC-DR;在验证集选超参的留出评测中，均匀IEWC在ImageNet-R上比匹配的EWC高2.00个百分点(95% CI 0.93–3.07)。

arxiv.title: Continual Event Recognition for Autonomous Optical Network Monitoring
arxiv.abstract: Autonomous optical networks require monitoring systems capable of adapting to evolving disturbances without repeated retraining or service interruption. We propose a continual event recognition framework for state-of-polarization (SOP)-based optical monitoring based on prototype representations, open-set recognition, and few-shot prototype registration. The framework supports recognition of known disturbances, detection and integration of novel events, and investigates whether overlapping disturbances can be inferred through compositional reasoning from existing prototypes. Experimental validation on a 2600-km ROADM-based optical testbed demonstrates 99.82% closed-set recognition accuracy, successful adaptation to novel disturbances without encoder retraining, and reveals that overlapping optical disturbances exhibit varying degrees of latent compositionality. While some overlaps can be recognized in a zero-shot manner through prototype composition, others require explicit few-shot registration. These results establish continual event recognition as a promising paradigm for future autonomous optical network monitoring systems.

arxiv.title: Robustness Within a Fairness Budget: Parity Frontiers and Equal-Opportunity Reversal
arxiv.abstract: Adversarial training protects predictive performance under attack but does not determine how decisions are distributed across protected groups. We formulate binary classification as projected gradient descent (PGD) adversarial-risk minimization under a squared soft demographic-parity (DP) budget, optimized with projected multiplier and one-sided penalty updates. On Adult Income, using the binary sex field supplied by the benchmark for group auditing but excluding it from prediction, we test logistic regression and a one-hidden-layer multilayer perceptron (MLP) across three paired seeds, four PGD strengths, and five budgets. At $\varepsilon=0.3$, PGD training improves balanced accuracy over empirical-risk minimization (ERM) by $7.77$ and $11.45$ percentage points and removes $85.7\%$ and $89.5\%$ of attack-induced growth in hard demographic-parity difference (DPD). At the representative interior value $τ=0.015$, constrained training cuts DPD relative to PGD training by $52.2\%$ and $49.2\%$, while remaining $3.18$ and $8.34$ balanced-accuracy points above ERM. Across all eight seed-averaged model-attack paths, the sampled budget path strictly orders DPD and accuracy and reverses mean signed equal-opportunity difference (EOpp). A rate theorem gives the exact true-positive-rate shift required for reversal, and the measured group rates satisfy it. Within this controlled feature-space study, robustness and parity admit useful joint operating points, but one fairness metric cannot replace a full group-rate audit.

arxiv.title: A Unified Interpretable Semantic Framework for Multi-Modal Fiber Sensing Under Data Scarcity
arxiv.abstract: We propose a unified interpretable semantic framework for multi-modal fiber sensing under data scarcity. The framework maps heterogeneous measurements from state of-polarization (SOP) monitoring, distributed acoustic sensing (DAS), and optical time-domain reflectometry (OTDR) into a shared set of physics-grounded semantic descriptors capturing impulsiveness, persistence, structural characteristics, and energy concentration. Inference is performed through reasoning over semantic class profiles, optionally assisted by retrieval of semantically similar examples to resolve ambiguity and support adaptation without model retraining. Experimental validation on real SOP, DAS, and OTDR datasets demonstrates robust performance across sensing modalities, achieving accuracies of 95.0%, 91.1%, and 94.6%, respectively, while providing transparent and physically interpretable decisions. The proposed framework establishes a unified and data efficient approach for optical fiber sensing in evolving and data scarce deployment environments.

arxiv.title: Imitating the Imperfect: Offline-to-Online Robust Imitation Learning from Heterogeneous Demonstrators
arxiv.abstract: Imitation learning (IL) typically relies on large-scale offline demonstrations collected from multiple human or algorithmic demonstrators. However, most existing approaches assume these demonstrators are homogeneous or near-optimal experts, a convenient but unrealistic assumption in real-world applications. In practice, demonstrations are often collected from heterogeneous demonstrators with unknown and varying levels of expertise, resulting in highly mixed-quality data. In this work, we study a challenging yet practical setting of imitation learning from such heterogeneous imperfect demonstrators. We propose Latent Expertise and Optimality Scoring based Imitation Learning (LEOS-IL), a principled framework that jointly learns (i) a state-action optimality scoring model and (ii) latent expertise levels for each demonstrator from unlabeled suboptimal offline demonstrations. The learned scoring model is then integrated into an online policy optimization procedure, where the agent is trained to maximize estimated optimality scores while its online rollouts are iteratively leveraged to refine the scoring model, thereby mitigating distributional shift during online adaptation. We further provide theoretical guarantees for optimality score identification and conditional optimal occupancy and policy recovery under explicit sufficient conditions. Experiments on continuous control benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms existing baselines across highly heterogeneous and low-quality demonstration regimes.

arxiv.title: Protocol-Aware Auditing of Domain-Blind Feature Attribution in Network Intrusion Detection
arxiv.abstract: Feature-attribution methods can query rule-violating network states through perturbations, coalitions, references, paths, and ablations, making explanations and their evaluation sensitive to model behavior outside the operational domain. We formalize this failure mode as domain blindness and prove valid-query invariance: when models agree on the required oracle information within a declared rule-valid set, a procedure confined to that set returns the same attribution. We instantiate one protocol-aware query-control principle in LIME, SHAP, Integrated Gradients, and DeepLIFT and audit paired configurations across four NIDS datasets and three classifier families. In six settings where standard LIME reports perfect top-feature repeatability, PA-LIME reveals substantial variability, with a mean of 0.575. Under FGSM followed by protocol repair, PA-DeepLIFT and PA-IG achieve the largest attribution-similarity curve areas, 0.452 and 0.413, while mean within-PA rank agreement rises to 0.366 from 0.217. PA-XAI therefore turns structured domain assumptions into explicit, testable controls for explanation auditing; support modeling, raw-flow reconstruction, and adaptive explanation attacks provide complementary validation layers.

arxiv.title: Runtime Analysis of Cartesian Genetic Programming on Max: A Proven Exponential Speedup
arxiv.abstract: Genetic Programming (GP) is a search paradigm inspired from natural evolution for the automated discovery of expressions, functions, and computer programs. Cartesian GP (CGP) is a flavor of GP that uses a graph-based model to encode candidate programs, as contrasted to the conventional Tree-based GP (TGP). Since its inception two decades ago, CGP has predominantly been analyzed empirically, thus little is known regarding its theoretical performance guarantees. This paper analyzes CGP for the Max problem, which has been only rigorously studied for TGP with a proven expected runtime superlinear in the optimal program length $n$. We prove that the expected time for the ($1$+$1$)~CGP employing common mutation operators to evolve an equivalent optimal of the same output is polylogarithmic in $n$, specifically at most $O(\log^9{n})$. This is remarkable, as it shows an exponential speedup by switching to CGP. Our results shed light on the benefit and the compactness of the graph-based representation for programs, and on how CGP can navigate its search and fitness spaces efficiently. This is a first proven performance guarantee for CGP on an established benchmark problem. Experiments complement our theoretical findings.

arxiv.titleZh: 笛卡尔遗传编程在 Max 问题上的运行时分析：一个被证明的指数级加速
arxiv.summaryZh: 笛卡尔遗传编程（CGP）长期只有经验性研究，缺乏理论性能保证；相比之下，树状 GP（TGP）在 Max 基准上的期望运行时间已知是超线性的，与最优程序长度 n 相关。论文证明，采用常见变异算子的 (1+1) CGP 进化出输出等价的、与最优程序等价的程序所需的期望时间仅为 O(log^9 n)。这一多项对数上界意味着，改用 CGP 能带来指数级加速，也是 CGP 在经典基准问题上首个被证明的性能保证；论文还辅以实验验证，说明基于图的程序表示更紧凑，CGP 能更高效地搜索和适应度空间。

arxiv.title: Fit-LRP: Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes for Neural Network Verification over Non-Convex Regions
arxiv.abstract: State-of-the-art neural network verifiers evaluate linear relaxations over axis-aligned bounding boxes. However, verification domains in cyber-physical systems are rarely boxes. Reachability specifications, obstacle-avoidance constraints, and neural Lyapunov certificates typically yield oblique or non-convex polyhedral regions, over which box-based bounds become extremely loose. This paper proposes Fit-LRP (Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes), a framework the implements exact optimization of affine bounds over non-convex domains (represented by unions of polytopes) by solving a sequence of small, low-dimensional linear programs. Our approach seamlessly enhances the final optimization step of LiRPA and $α,\! β$-CROWN branch-and-bound (BaB) algorithms. In BaB verification, approximating oblique constraints with axis-aligned splits causes severe combinatorial blowup and risks non-termination. By optimizing the final affine bound of a nonlinear function over the exact polyhedral state-space constraints our method eliminates box-induced over-approximations, enabling earlier search-tree pruning. On ARCH-COMP and neural Lyapunov benchmarks, Fit-LRP reduces branching on the hardest region by $47\times$, cuts worst-case verification time by $15\times$, and with region-wise partitioning, verifies on a single CPU $6.1\times$ faster than $α,\! β$-CROWN on a GPU.
arxiv.titleZh: Fit-LRP:将线性松弛拟合到多面体，用于非凸区域上的神经网络验证
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有神经网络验证器多在轴对齐包围盒上求线性松弛，而信息物理系统中的可达性、避障与神经 Lyapunov 约束往往形成斜置或非凸多面体区域，盒式界因此极松。Fit-LRP 把仿射界在由多面体并集表示的非凸域上的精确优化拆解为一串低维小线性规划，无缝嵌入 LiRPA 与 α,β-CROWN 分支定界(BaB)的最终优化步骤，从而消除盒式过近似、提前剪枝，缓解斜约束下轴对齐分裂导致的组合爆炸与非终止风险。在 ARCH-COMP 与神经 Lyapunov 基准上，最难区域分支数减少 47 倍，最坏验证时间缩短 15 倍，配合区域划分后在单 CPU 上比 GPU 版 α,β-CROWN 快 6.1 倍。

arxiv.title: Characterizing the Edge of Stability in Variational Training Without Priors
arxiv.abstract: Variational approaches in deep learning promise to deliver improved uncertainty quantification and out-of-distribution generalization by inferring a distribution over weights, regularized by a divergence to a chosen prior. However, prior elicitation presents a significant challenge in deep learning, resulting in the common practice of significantly downweighting the regularization term in the variational objective. Recently, it was proposed to train solely via the expected loss by relying on implicit regularization from the optimizer, rather than explicit regularization from the divergence to the prior. While this approach largely sidesteps the issue of prior elicitation, current theory lacks an understanding of how key optimization hyperparameters impact the implicit regularization. Here, we theoretically and empirically demonstrate that larger learning rates and fewer parameter samples lead to flatter minima of the loss landscape, which are known to generalize better. We show that training on the expected loss operates at a modified edge of stability, characterized by the signal-to-noise ratio of the gradient estimates and the number of Monte Carlo samples. Experiments on out-of-distribution benchmark datasets confirm the practical significance of the theoretical results.

arxiv.titleZh: 无先验变分训练中稳定边缘的刻画
arxiv.summaryZh: 变分训练依赖与先验的散度做正则，但深度学习里先验难以设定，实践中常把正则项大幅降权；新近做法索性只用期望损失训练，靠优化器的隐式正则替代显式先验。该工作从理论与实验两方面说明：学习率越大、参数采样数越少，收敛到的极小值越平坦（对应更好的泛化），且此时训练运行在一个被修正的「稳定边缘」上，其位置由梯度估计的信噪比与 Monte Carlo 样本数共同决定。在分布外（OOD）基准数据集上的实验验证了上述结论的实际意义，为变分训练的超参数选择提供了理论依据。

arxiv.title: What Roles Do System Prompts Really Assign? Validating and Steering Occupational Role Vectors in LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Applications built on large language models assign the model a role through its system prompt, intending to shape how it responds for their use case. We introduce a validation framework for extracting and injecting occupational role vectors, activation-level directions that capture how someone in a given occupational role would distinctively respond to a task or question. We validate these vectors through two complementary lenses, on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The interpretability lens asks whether each vector is a stable, separable, domain-consistent representation of its role: extracted vectors are highly reproducible across repeated runs and sampling temperatures, remain separable even for very similar roles, and agree more with themselves across in-domain and out-of-domain questions than with other roles' signal. The control lens asks whether injecting a role vector during generation makes the model express the role, and sustain it over a conversation, as well as a role prompt does. On Qwen, injecting the vector alone makes the model express the intended role substantially more often than unsteered, but at best matches a role prompt; on both models, adding the vector to the prompt strengthens the role in single answers but did not slow the role's decline over 30 turns. Together, the two lenses show why both are needed: out of domain the role is expressed only subtly, yet the activations still encode it; and a vector that is stable and separable can still barely steer the model's behavior.

arxiv.titleZh: 系统提示究竟分配了哪些角色？验证与引导 LLM 中的职业角色向量
arxiv.summaryZh: 系统提示通过给模型指定职业角色来塑造回答风格，但角色在激活层如何表示、能否被直接控制尚不清楚。工作在 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 与 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上提取职业角色的激活方向向量，并从两个角度验证:可解释性角度检查向量在不同采样温度与重复运行下的可复现性、相近角色间的可分性以及域内外一致性;控制角度检查生成时注入向量能否让模型表达并维持该角色。结果显示向量高度可复现且对相近角色仍可区分，注入向量后 Qwen 表达目标角色的频率显著高于无引导，但最好也只与角色提示持平;将向量叠加到提示上能增强单轮回答中的角色强度，却未能减缓 30 轮对话中角色衰减。这说明稳定可分的表征未必带来有效的行 为控制，角色提示的局限也难以靠激活干预弥补。

arxiv.title: Better Boundary Prediction Does Not Guarantee Better Structural Representation
arxiv.abstract: Punctuation marks often mark phrase boundaries, carrying linguistic information. Therefore, punctuation marks' abundance and feasibility as proxies of linguistic structure has led to suggestions that using punctuation marks to optimise on phrasal structure may help language models (LMs) improve their representations of argument, semantic, and syntactic structures. In this paper, we test the above claim in English across three primary LM architectures: decoder-only, encoder-only, and encoder-decoder LMs, by complementing traditional token prediction with punctuation restoration (PR). Our evidence, collected at the <1B parameter scale, suggests that optimising for boundary prediction does not necessarily guarantee higher-quality structural representation in decoder-only, encoder-decoder, and encoder-only LMs, failing to improve performance on downstream tasks that require understanding structure in linguistic input.

arxiv.titleZh: 更好的边界预测并不保证更好的结构表征
arxiv.summaryZh: 标点常标记短语边界，被视作语言结构的廉价代理，因此有观点认为用标点恢复（PR）作为辅助目标可让语言模型学到更好的句法、语义与论元结构表征。该工作在英文上对decoder-only、encoder-only、encoder-decoder三类架构（参数量均小于1B）在常规token预测之外加入标点恢复目标进行验证。结果显示，边界预测性能提升并未带来下游结构理解任务的改善，三类架构均如此。这说明「边界预测变好即结构表征变好」的假设不成立，提示以代理任务指标推断表征质量需更谨慎的实验设计。

arxiv.title: Subject-Held-Out Evaluation of Deep Ground Reaction Force Estimators Across Two Laboratories: Leakage and Cross-Laboratory Transfer
arxiv.abstract: Deep networks that estimate ground reaction forces and centers of pressure from motion-capture markers are validated within one laboratory, in a seldom-stated coordinate frame, and sometimes with trial-level splits that put the same person in the training and the test set. We measured what each practice costs, and whether such models transfer between laboratories. Three sequence models (convolutional, convolutional-recurrent, and convolutional-transformer) were evaluated on two independent datasets, locomotion (6 subjects) and occupational patient handling (10 subjects), under one pipeline, one tuning procedure, three seeds, and four protocols: trial-level split, leave-one-subject-out, pooled two-laboratory training with matched held-out subjects, and cross-laboratory transfer. At a fixed configuration, trial-level splits overstated the subject-held-out coefficient of determination by +0.040 to +0.194; on occupational data the overstatement exceeded every difference between architectures. With subjects held out, the three models reached values between 0.583 and 0.804; the leader differed between datasets, and gaps lay within subject-to-subject variability. Pooling the laboratories changed neither dataset on matched subjects. Transfer between laboratories was below chance in both directions, including the vertical force, which no in-plane rotation can affect. Leaving force targets in the plate frame while inputs were heading-aligned cost 0.57 of locomotion anteroposterior-force explained variance, enough to make that force look hardest; a Newton's-law correlation detected the mismatch before training. Split protocol and target frame changed reported accuracy more than architecture did. Learned force estimators should be validated with subjects held out, checked for frame consistency before training, and tested across laboratories before deployment claims are made.

arxiv.summaryZh: 针对基于动捕标记估计地面反作用力与压力中心的深度网络，通常只在单实验室验证、坐标系未加说明，且按试次划分数据，导致同一受试者同时出现在训练集与测试集中；该工作量化了这些做法的代价，并检验了跨实验室迁移性。在运动（6 名受试者）与职业搬运（10 名受试者）两个独立数据集上，用卷积、卷积循环与卷积Transformer 三种序列模型，统一流程、调参、三个随机种子与四种评估协议（试次划分、留一受试者、匹配受试者的两实验室合并训练、跨实验室迁移）进行比较。试次级划分将受试者留出的决定系数高估 +0.040 至 +0.194；受试者留出时三模型为 0.583 至 0.804，模型差距落在受试者间变异之内；跨实验室迁移双向均低于随机水平，而将力目标留在测力台坐标系造成的失配使运动前向力解释方差损失 0.57，可用牛顿定律相关性在训练前检出。划分协议与目标坐标系对报告精度的影响大于架构本身。

arxiv.title: PhysICL: In-Context Learning of Physical Fields on Unstructured Meshes from Procedural Priors
arxiv.abstract: Engineering design studies produce a few tens to a few hundred simulations of one problem, each on its own mesh, and their surrogates are retrained for every study. Tabular foundation models instead infer a new task from its examples in one forward pass, after pretraining on synthetic tasks. We demonstrate the feasibility of in-context learning for physical field prediction on unstructured meshes. A single model, PhysICL, pretrained solely on procedural tasks, predicts fields, with quantiles, directly on each query mesh from labeled simulations, without updating its weights. The same checkpoint accepts variable numbers of context examples, scalar inputs and input fields, and any number of output fields, while mesh size and connectivity can vary within a task. Its procedural prior draws generic laws and boundary-element physical models on morphed 2D and 3D template meshes, evaluated only at the points the model samples, fast enough that tasks generated on the fly by CPU workers keep the GPUs busy throughout pretraining. On five PLAID datasets never seen in pretraining, its field error decreases as the context grows and, from $K = 32$, is below that of the nearest context simulation on every dataset and context draw. It is on par with per-dataset reduced-order models on two of them, behind them where the fields are low-rank. On AhmedML surfaces with a median of 1.1 million nodes, twenty times the largest pretraining mesh, its fixed spatial budgets keep the peak GPU memory at $K = 64$ at 4.27 GiB, against 4.07 GiB on the 6,000-node meshes of 2D\_MSHE. Finally, on 2D\_MSHE, far from the prior, fine-tuning on procedural tasks that reproduce its geometry and loads, without any of its outputs, at a tenth of the pretraining cost, divides the stress error by 2.7.
arxiv.titleZh: PhysICL:基于过程先验的非结构网格物理场上下文学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 工程仿真研究通常只有几十到几百条样本，且每条样本网格不同，代理模型需逐项重训。PhysICL 仅在程序化任务上预训练，即可在单次前向中对新任务的非结构网格直接预测物理场及分位数，无需更新权重，并支持可变上下文样本数、标量/场输入与任意数量输出场。过程先验在变形 2D/3D 模板网格上生成通用物理定律与边界元模型，由 CPU worker 实时生成任务以喂满 GPU。在五个未见过的 PLAID 数据集上，场误差随上下文增大而下降，K=32 时已优于最近的上下文仿真;在 110 万节点的 AhmedML 上，K=64 时峰值显存仍为 4.27 GiB，与 6000 节点 2D_MSHE 的 4.07 GiB 相当。该工作验证了网格无关的上下文学习作为仿真代理的可行性，适合少样本工程设计场景。

arxiv.title: WELP : Weighted Ensemble in the LooP for committor learning
arxiv.abstract: Understanding how complex molecular systems transition between metastable states is a central challenge in computational chemistry and biophysics. A key tool for characterizing these transitions is the committor function: the probability that a trajectory initiated from a given configuration reaches one state before another. Because the committor encodes both the progress and the mechanism of a transition, it is an ideal collective variable (CV). Learning it, however, requires sampling the rare transitions it describes. We address this circular dependency with a ``WE-in-the-loop'' framework that couples committor learning with weighted ensemble (WE), an enhanced sampling method that uses a CV to drive transition dynamics. Our framework alternates between the two: WE simulation generates transition data for training a neural network committor with a self-consistent loss, and the learned committor then serves as an improved CV for subsequent WE simulation. Across a two-channel 2D system, alanine dipeptide, and chignolin, our framework consistently outperforms greedy baselines, highlighting the importance of principled exploration. We also curate a public benchmark of empirically determined committor values for alanine dipeptide. Together, the framework and benchmark provide a new method for studying rare transitions in high-dimensional molecular systems and a standard for evaluating committor learning methods.

arxiv.titleZh: WELP:用于 committor 学习的环内加权集合方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 分子体系在亚稳态之间的稀有跃迁难以采样，而刻画跃迁的 committor 函数又必须靠这些稀有事件来学习，形成循环依赖。WELP 把 committor 学习与加权集合(WE)增强采样交替耦合:WE 用当前 collective variable 驱动生成跃迁数据，神经网络以自洽损失拟合 committor，学到的 committor 再作为更优 CV 回灌下一轮 WE。在双通道二维体系、丙氨酸二肽与 chignolin 上均稳定优于贪心基线，并公开了丙氨酸二肽 committor 经验值基准。

arxiv.title: Is Spoken Hungarian Low-resource?: A Quantitative Survey of Hungarian Speech Data Sets
arxiv.abstract: Even though various speech data sets are available in Hungarian, there is a lack of a general overview about their types and sizes. To fill in this gap, we provide a survey of available data sets in spoken Hungarian in five categories (e.g., monolingual, Hungarian part of multilingual, pathological, child-related and dialectal collections). In total, the estimated size of available data is about 2800 hours (across 7500 speakers) and it represents a rich spoken language diversity. However, the distribution of the data and its alignment to real-life (e.g. speech recognition) tasks is far from optimal indicating the need for additional larger-scale natural language speech data sets. Our survey presents an overview of available data sets for Hungarian explaining their strengths and weaknesses which is useful for researchers working on Hungarian across disciplines. In addition, our survey serves as a starting point towards a unified foundational speech model specific to Hungarian.

arxiv.title: Riordan Arrays as Structured Operators for Artificial Intelligence
arxiv.abstract: Riordan arrays have traditionally been studied as infinite lower-triangular matrices that encode generating-function transformations and combinatorial relationships. This note proposes a complementary direction: using Riordan arrays as structured operators in artificial intelligence and data analysis. For a data sequence with generating function $A(z)$, a Riordan array $(g(z),f(z))$ produces the transformation \[ A(z)\longmapsto g(z)A(f(z)). \] This yields a parameterized family of causal linear operators that combine convolution, substitution, and multiscale mixing. The resulting structure may support parameter-efficient neural-network layers, variable-length sequence models, interpretable recurrent systems, invertible architectures, and models for hierarchical or recursively generated data. We explain what the infinite-dimensional viewpoint does and does not provide, outline several possible architectures, identify theoretical and numerical challenges, and propose an initial experimental program. The aim is not to claim that Riordan arrays are appropriate for all data, but to identify settings in which their algebraic structure supplies a useful inductive bias.
arxiv.titleZh: Riordan 阵列作为人工智能中的结构化算子
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对序列建模中卷积、替换与多尺度混合难以统一参数化的问题，提出把组合数学中的 Riordan 阵列用作 AI 中的结构化线性算子:对生成函数为 A(z) 的数据序列，阵列 (g(z),f(z)) 施加 A(z)↦g(z)A(f(z)) 的变换，从而得到一族参数化的因果线性算子。文中讨论了该无穷维视角能提供与不能提供什么，勾勒出参数高效网络层、变长序列模型、可解释循环系统与可逆架构等可能形式，并列出理论与数值上的挑战及初步实验计划。该工作为位置性 note，不含实验结果，价值在于指出何种数据适合以这种代数结构作为归纳偏置。

arxiv.title: Reinforcement Learning for Inventory Control under Regime-Switching Demand: A Controlled Comparison of LSTM, MLP, and (s,S) Policies
arxiv.abstract: Classical inventory policies such as (s,S) are provably optimal under stationary demand but cannot adapt when demand switches between hidden regimes, and memoryless deep reinforcement learning policies, confined to a fixed observation window, cannot maintain a belief over latent demand structure. We ask whether a recurrent policy offers a measurable advantage over both a memoryless policy and a classical baseline under regime-switching demand, and how that advantage scales with supply-chain lead time. We build a custom Gymnasium environment in which daily demand is generated by a two-state hidden Markov process with Poisson emissions, so that the regime is known at evaluation time but hidden from the agent. An optimised (s,S) heuristic, an MLP PPO agent, and an LSTM Recurrent PPO agent are trained under matched compute and evaluated at lead times of 0, 3, 6, and 10 days over 30 deterministic episodes each. The recurrent policy outperforms both alternatives at every lead time, and its margin over the MLP widens monotonically with lead time, from parity at lead time 0 to 2.17$\times$ at lead time 10. Principal component analysis of the LSTM hidden state explains the widening gap: the representation shifts from encoding a binary regime indicator at short lead times to encoding multi-step pipeline state at long lead times. Recurrent memory becomes the decisive architectural factor as the credit-assignment horizon lengthens.
arxiv.titleZh: 需求机制切换下的库存控制强化学习：LSTM、MLP 与（s,S）策略的受控比较
arxiv.summaryZh: 经典（s,S）策略在平稳需求下可证最优，但当需求在隐藏机制间切换时无法适应；而受限于固定观测窗口的无记忆深度强化学习策略也无法维持对潜在需求结构的信念。作者构建了基于两状态隐马尔可夫过程（泊松发射）的自定义 Gymnasium 环境，在匹配算力下训练优化后的（s,S）启发式、MLP PPO 与 LSTM 循环 PPO 三种策略，并在提前期 0、3、6、10 天下各用 30 个确定性回合评估。循环策略在所有提前期上均优于两个对照，且相对 MLP 的优势随提前期单调扩大，从提前期 0 的持平到提前期 10 的 2.17 倍；对 LSTM 隐状态的主成分分析显示，表征从短提前期编码二值机制指示量转向长提前期编码多步在途状态。

arxiv.title: ShadowBench: Exposing Lexical Anchoring and the Illusion of Forgetting in Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as primary interfaces for factual retrieval, yet current evaluation paradigms rely almost exclusively on explicit entity names. In this work, we demonstrate that LLM knowledge is fundamentally lexically anchored: models possess extensive factual information but find it significantly difficult to retrieve without explicit name tokens. To quantify this limitation, we introduce ShadowBench, a rigorously hardened, shortcut-resistant benchmark designed to evaluate Latent Entity Association via a novel Dual-Trait Association (DTA) task. Our evaluation reveals a pervasive "Shadow Gap" across all model scales$\unicode{x2013}$up to the frontier models GPT-5.4 and Claude-Sonnet-4.6$\unicode{x2013}$where removing lexical anchors causes performance drops of over 20%. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this lexical dependency exposes a critical vulnerability in AI safety. Applying ShadowBench to Machine Unlearning, we find that state-of-the-art algorithms (e.g., Gradient Difference, NPO) achieve only superficial lexical erasure. While unlearned models fail on direct queries, our novel Latent Entity Leakage Rate (LELR) metric reveals that for popular entities, models explicitly reconstruct the "forgotten" entity in their internal reasoning traces in over 74% of cases, utilizing residual shadow knowledge to solve associative tasks. Conversely, for niche entities, models retain high shadow accuracy (60-90%) via implicit attribute correlation despite 0% LELR. Ultimately, ShadowBench indicates that current unlearning paradigms create an "Illusion of Forgetting," demonstrating that existing methods act as superficial output filters and are not yet reliable for achieving true parametric erasure.

arxiv.titleZh: ShadowBench：揭示大语言模型中的词面锚定与遗忘错觉

arxiv.title: Spec-Driven PBT: Deriving Semantic Invariants from Code Specifications for Agentic Property-based Testing
arxiv.abstract: Software is increasingly written by AI agents that produce an implementation from a natural language specification, a practice known as agentic coding. Code is now produced faster than it can be reviewed, and has been shown to exhibit its own characteristic failure patterns. Property-based testing (PBT), a long-standing technique in which invariant properties of a program are checked against many generated inputs, has recently been revisited with LLM agents authoring the properties, thereby removing the high-effort derivation of invariants that has long hindered its adoption. Existing methods, however, derive these properties from the implementation alone (Code-driven PBT). At the same time, a thorough specification such as a product requirements document has become routine within agentic coding, yet its role in testing the resulting code remains underexplored. We study the value of the specification as a source of properties for testing agent-written code. Our key insight is that the specification, unlike the implementation, records what the code was meant to do, and invariants derived from it are not biased by particular implementation choices. We propose Spec-Driven PBT, an agent that first expresses invariants in natural language from the specification and only then inspects the implementation to translate them into concrete tests. Across 25 applications from ViBench, Spec-Driven PBT finds a novel set of bugs that Code-driven PBT misses, while writing 2.4x fewer property tests. Though the two approaches surface a roughly equivalent number of bugs, there is little overlap: nearly 60% of the 169 total bugs are found by only one. Qualitatively, we find that the bugs unique to Spec-Driven PBT tend to violate documented product workflows whereas those to Code-driven PBT instead concentrate on implementation robustness, offering complementary value for bug discovery in agent-written code.

arxiv.titleZh: Spec-Driven PBT：从代码规格中导出语义不变量，用于智能体属性测试

arxiv.title: Owned Edits to a Shared Decision Rule: Learning Private Exceptions as Typed, Gated, Withdrawable Weight Edits
arxiv.abstract: Organisations that apply the same published decision rule often hold private evidence that the rule is wrong for their own cases, and will not pool it. We describe a learning mechanism for that setting whose unit of change is an owned edit. The published rule is compiled exactly into a small ReLU network, a structured prior. Each party's learner searches a small typed space of declarations, a few named values such as subject, scope, form and size, and proposes one only when its own records pass a selection-aware evidence gate. The learning is that gated search around the prior. In two analyses registered before they ran, on synthetic data with 20 sampled hidden truths, the learner at 30 records per party was non-inferior, within 2 points, to all seven tuned baselines (a confined gradient learner, Ditto, FedRep, federated averaging, two pooled networks and pooled gradient-boosted trees), scoring 96.6% against 91.7% for the unchanged rule; the same search without the prior or the gate scored 84.0%. In a third registered test, typed edits over a network trained on shared records beat that network alone by 5.4 points and the same edits over the published rule by 3.1. An acceptance body recomputes each edit from its declaration and writes it into units reserved for that party, so by construction an edit changes no decision about any other subject, withdraws exactly, discloses at most log2 of the typed space's size in bits, and can hide nothing beyond its declared values. We report where it loses: truths shared by all parties, relaxations, ten records, a pre-stated gate criterion that failed in both runs, and a language model given the records that decided about as accurately on one draw. On a rule-only base, a table of owned exceptions makes the same decisions.

arxiv.title: HeriKGQA: Grounded Knowledge-Graph Question Answering over Cultural Heritage Sensor Data
arxiv.abstract: Cultural heritage sites are increasingly monitored by sensor networks, but querying their data requires database expertise. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a natural-language interface, yet over raw sensor records they lose track of which sensor, site, and time each value belongs to, and silently miscompute. We present HeriKGQA, a knowledge-graph question-answering method that confines the LLM to interpreting questions and phrasing answers, leaving computation to SPARQL and deterministic code. Questions are parsed into intents constrained by a heritage ontology aligning W3C SOSA/SSN with CIDOC-CRM, compiled into SPARQL, and answered from query results and temporal, spatial, and anomaly facts derived by a grounding layer, with error correction guarding each LLM step. On 500 questions over real data from five heritage sites, HeriKGQA reaches 99.0% accuracy, 18.2 points above the strongest of three baselines using the same LLM and receiving the same anomaly rules and answer conventions, with comparable answer quality while running almost four times faster. Without grounding, accuracy drops by 12.2 points and on anomaly questions from 99% to 66%. We report lessons from development and live deployment.

arxiv.titleZh: HeriKGQA:面向文化遗产传感器数据的可溯源知识图谱问答

arxiv.title: Your Hypergradient is Skewed: Antithetic Neumann Estimation for Bilevel Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Bilevel optimization is a core tool in practical machine learning workflows, including hyperparameter tuning, data reweighting, robust learning, reinforcement learning, and imbalanced classification. Hypergradient computation requires the inverse of the inner Hessian, typically estimated via a truncated Neumann series. While existing analyses focus on bias and variance, we show that the product structure of the Neumann series introduces a third source of error: skewness. We identify that, unlike ordinary gradients, whose asymmetry is suppressed by mini-batch averaging, the Neumann estimator amplifies skewness across factors, with the third-moment error growing, under weak contraction, with truncation depth, inner condition number, and per-factor noise asymmetry. This arises in many practical settings such as corrupted labels, outliers, heterogeneous or class-imbalanced datasets. To address this, we introduce the Antithetic Neumann Estimator (ANE), which pairs each Hessian sample with a mirrored counterpart around a reference Hessian and averages the resulting inverse-Hessian estimates. With an exact reference, the antithetic product retains only even-order noise, eliminating all odd-order perturbation terms; with an approximate reference, the residual odd-order contribution is bounded linearly in the reference error. ANE requires only a modification of the Hessian vector step and combines with existing stochastic or variance-reduced bilevel methods. We instantiate ANE-SGD and ANE-VR, the latter adding recursive variance reduction. Across robust regression, data cleaning, offline reinforcement learning, and imbalanced classification, ANE-based methods improve on stochastic and variance-reduced baselines on every task (20 seeds each), lowering loss by 4 to 25% relative to the best baseline; the largest gains, on robust regression, are a 25% lower test loss and a 54% higher test r-squared.

arxiv.titleZh: 你的超梯度是偏斜的：面向双层优化的对偶 Neumann 估计
arxiv.summaryZh: 双层优化的超梯度计算需内层 Hessian 逆，通常用截断 Neumann 级数估计；已有分析关注偏差与方差，该工作指出级数乘积结构引入第三种误差——偏斜，且不会被小批量平均抑制，反而随截断深度、内层条件数与单因子噪声非对称性增长。提出对偶 Neumann 估计（ANE）：把每个 Hessian 采样与关于参考 Hessian 的镜像样本配对后平均，参考精确时只保留偶数阶噪声项、消去全部奇数阶扰动，参考近似时残差随参考误差线性有界；仅需改动 Hessian-vector 步，可与随机及方差缩减双层方法组合。在稳健回归、数据清洗、离线 RL、不平衡分类上均优于基线，损失降低 4%–25%，稳健回归上 R² 提升 54%。

arxiv.title: Reward-Driven Collider Physics Challenges for Self-Improving Agentic AI via Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in agentic AI have demonstrated the potential to automate complex high-energy physics (HEP) workflows. We focus on the regime of HEP tasks where frontier models still struggle to provide correct and complete solutions, and introduce an open-ended optimization task format with continuous, automatically evaluated rewards. Unlike conventional benchmarks focused on task completion, these tasks target reinforcement learning (RL) environments to generate agentic improvement on state- of-the-art HEP challenges. We benchmark frontier reasoning models on several HEP tasks and demonstrate an initial proof of concept in which a small language model improves through RL using automated feedback without human intervention. By connecting challenging HEP problems with verifiable scientific rewards and RL, we aim to advance agentic AI from reproducing established workflows to autonomously discovering better scientific solutions, paving the way toward self-improving scientific agents.
arxiv.titleZh: 奖励驱动的对撞机物理挑战：基于强化学习实现自我改进的 Agentic AI

arxiv.title: Food Critic: An Agentic Visualization System for Auditable Restaurant-Safety Reasoning
arxiv.abstract: Generative AI agents are increasingly being embedded into visualization systems that can search data, invoke tools, summarize evidence, and produce recommendations. However, when agents rely solely on their own knowledge, the visualization problem is not only whether the agent provides a useful answer, but also whether users can inspect how that answer is grounded. We present Food Critic, an agentic visualization system for diners' restaurant decision support that integrates public health inspection records with crowd review data. The system grounds agents under three conditions: a database-only ReAct agent, a retrieval- augmented agent with access to food-safety regulations, and an ontology-guided agent that produces structured hypotheses and typed evidence. Food Critic externalizes the agent's reasoning within these groundings as inspectable visual evidence. We evaluate LLM models with several use cases under each grounding of our agentic system. Our work positions restaurant choice as a concrete case for studying human-agent collaboration, visual provenance of agent reasoning, and the design of visual interfaces for grounded GenAI decision support.

arxiv.title: Fewer Expert Transfers Without Changing Routing: Expert Eviction for MoE Offloading
arxiv.abstract: A mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model uses only a few experts per token, so a server can keep most expert weights in CPU memory and copy an expert to the GPU when the router requests it. Recent methods train the router to keep the same experts for several tokens, and treat fewer routing switches as a proxy for fewer copies. We measure the trade-off directly, in a harness that performs and times real CPU-to-GPU copies for OLMoE-1B-7B. On an L40S GPU, every tested policy that holds an expert set fixed and decodes faster than the least-recently-used (LRU) cache increases next-token loss by at least 0.067 nats. A change that leaves every routing decision intact does better: when the cache must evict an expert, evict the one whose next use lies farthest in the future. This rule copies 2.1x fewer experts than LRU at no loss in quality and is within 3.5% of the fewest copies possible. It needs future requests; the next sixteen tokens of demand recover 96% of its reduction, whereas a rule based on counts of past requests recovers 27%.

arxiv.titleZh: 不改路由也能减少专家传输：MoE 卸载中的专家驱逐
arxiv.summaryZh: MoE 推理卸载把专家权重放在 CPU 内存、按路由按需拷入 GPU，已有做法通过训练路由器让多个 token 复用同一批专家以减少拷贝，但会损害模型质量。该工作在 OLMoE-1B-7B 上实测真实 CPU-to-GPU 拷贝：凡固定专家集合的策略，在 L40S 上虽解码更快，next-token loss 至少上升 0.067 nats。改为不触碰任何路由决策、只在驱逐时选“下次使用最远”的专家，拷贝次数比 LRU 少 2.1 倍且质量无损，已接近理论最少拷贝的 3.5% 以内；未来 16 个 token 的需求即可回收 96% 的收益，而基于历史请求计数的规则只能回收 27%。

arxiv.title: Before AI Agents Negotiate for Us: A Competitive Tournament of Rule-Based, Search, Optimization, Learned, and Language-Model Negotiators Under Scarcity
arxiv.abstract: Automated bilateral negotiation underlies two-sided matching markets such as freight brokering, where many shippers and carriers negotiate price before a matching mechanism decides who is paired with whom. Prior strategy comparisons typically use isolated one-on-one duels or a single fixed market, so they cannot show how a strategy behaves against several live rivals under a changing balance of supply and demand. We built nine negotiation architectures spanning rule-based, search-based, optimization-based, imitation-learning, and reinforcement-learning families, and ran all nine simultaneously on both sides of a Gale-Shapley matching market under a balanced condition and two scarcity conditions rotated across all 36 exclusion pairs. In the balanced carrier market, an imitation-learned engine (ML2), a reinforcement-learning policy trained only on isolated negotiations (RL), and an expected-utility optimization engine (OPT) formed a statistically tied top group, and no architecture led in every condition and role. RL beat all eight carrier rivals when carriers were scarce, but its match rate collapsed from 62% to 16% when shippers were scarce and it had to compete with the other carrier agents for demand. A second reinforcement-learning policy trained against rival agents (RL2) kept its match rate above 91% in every condition, yet lost on realized payoff to all eight shipper-side rivals in two of the three conditions, traced to a confirmed train/deployment feature mismatch. We also tested nine large language models (LLMs), from 1 to 72 billion parameters, under the same protocol: they lost significantly to the two strongest engines (OPT2 and ML2) in 32 of 36 comparisons and won none. These results show that isolated or single-condition evaluation can hide failure modes that a many-sided, scarcity-varying, statistically corrected tournament exposes directly.

arxiv.title: Controlling the Probability of Unknown Unknowns in Pre-Deployment Testing of AI Systems
arxiv.abstract: In pre-deployment testing of AI systems such as AI agents, a developer can often deal with known failure modes (e.g., leaking API keys, deleting important databases, or installing a malicious package) by implementing fixes or making contingency plans for when the same issue might occur again. What is more challenging are the unknown unknowns: the unseen failure modes that haven't surfaced during testing. The decision to stop testing and deploy therefore faces an inherent tradeoff: continue testing to observe more behaviors, at the cost of time and resources, or stop testing and deploy, at the risk of failure modes remaining undiscovered. How then does the developer decide when they have tested enough? To answer this, we develop an algorithm that certifies when the probability of observing an unseen failure mode is sufficiently small. The algorithm constructs an anytime-valid upper confidence sequence on this quantity, so the developer can repeatedly test a system, inspect the bound, and decide to stop when it falls below a chosen threshold without invalidating the statistical guarantee. Our problem can be interpreted as a sequential variant of the missing-mass estimation problem which gave rise to the classic Good-Turing estimator (Good, 1953). On SWE-Chat, a dataset of real-world coding agent traces (Baumann et al., 2026), we implement our procedure and show that it achieves tighter upper bounds than a simple multiple-testing corrected Good-Turing baseline, and even dominates a fixed-horizon (non-multiple-testing-corrected) Good-Turing upper confidence bound, which is not anytime valid. Additionally, to better match realistic evaluation pipelines, we extend our method to handle sampling from a different task distribution and imperfect automated failure labeling.

arxiv.titleZh: 在AI系统部署前测试中控制未知未知的概率
arxiv.summaryZh: AI系统（尤其是Agent）部署前测试常面临未知未知：未出现的失效模式难以枚举，开发者需在继续测试与停止部署之间权衡。该工作将停止问题建模为缺失质量估计的序贯版本，构造“观测到未见失效模式概率”的anytime-valid上置信序列，使开发者可反复查看后仍按阈值停止而不破坏统计保证。在真实编码Agent轨迹数据集SWE-Chat上，该方法的上界比多重检验校正的Good-Turing基线更紧，并优于非anytime-valid的固定时域Good-Turing上界，还扩展到任务分布偏移与自动失效标注不完美的情况。为Agent部署前测试提供了可操作的统计停止准则。

arxiv.title: NIBench: benchmarking autonomous AI agents for execution, skill evolution and scientific judgment in neuroimaging
arxiv.abstract: Autonomous AI agents are increasingly used to automate biomedical research, creating a growing need to benchmark their capabilities on real scientific data and workflows. Their reliability in neuroimaging remains insufficiently characterized, where plausible analytical outputs can conceal errors that affect scientific conclusions. Existing studies have advanced scientific question answering and tool-based automation, but provide limited evidence on workflow reconstruction, acquisition of procedural expertise and evidence-based scientific judgment. Here we present NIBench, a neuroimaging benchmark comprising three complementary evaluations of autonomous agents. First, we benchmark execution and workflow reconstruction using 56 tasks across seven tool ecosystems, covering structural, diffusion and functional magnetic resonance imaging, positron emission tomography and multimodal analyses. Second, we examine whether agents can evolve their procedural skills through distillation of execution trajectories, evaluating the resulting skills on previously encountered tasks, unseen tasks and other models. Third, we assess scientific judgment using 36 claims from published Alzheimer's disease studies, requiring agents to analyse raw cohort data and provide reproducible evidence. We evaluate 19 language models within a shared agent framework, with selected models undergoing skill distillation and claim evaluation. Leading agents execute supplied analysis protocols nearly perfectly, whereas withholding procedural guidance widens performance differences. Distilled skills improve performance on acquisition tasks and transfer between models, but benefits on unseen tasks are inconsistent. Agents reproduce their reported results yet sometimes reach conclusions inconsistent with expert-derived answers, and access to data does not always improve judgment.
arxiv.titleZh: NIBench：面向神经影像中执行、技能进化与科学判断的自主 AI Agent 基准测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 自主 Agent 在神经影像分析中可能产出看似合理却含有隐蔽错误的结论，现有评测对工作流复现、程序性技能获取与循证科学判断的覆盖不足。NIBench 由此构建三组互补评测：用 56 个任务、7 个工具生态考察结构像、扩散、功能磁共振、PET 与多模态分析的执行与流程重建；通过蒸馏执行轨迹检验技能能否在已见任务、未见任务与其他模型间迁移；并以 36 条已发表阿尔茨海默病研究的结论要求 Agent 分析原始队列数据、给出可复现证据。在统一 Agent 框架下评测 19 个语言模型，结果显示：给出分析协议时领先 Agent 几乎完美执行，撤去流程指引则差距显著拉大；蒸馏技能可在模型间迁移并提升习得任务表现，但对未见任务的增益不稳定；Agent 能复现自身报告的结果，却有时得出与专家答案相悖的结论，且提供数据访问并不总能改善判断。
arxiv.reason: Agent 基准与技能蒸馏有看点，但落在神经影像垂直领域，与主线仅擦边

arxiv.title: Training Calibrated Conditional Generative Models with a Sample-Only Coverage Loss
arxiv.abstract: Conditional generative models have become the tool of choice for sampling posteriors in scientific inverse problems, where we seek to sample images or signals conditioned on a set of indirect and noisy measurements. Yet they are often overconfident, which is a critical failure in scientific applications where accurate uncertainty quantification is essential. Existing regularizers fall short in complementary ways: differentiable coverage objectives require the model's density and do not identify the posterior, while strictly proper scoring rules such as the energy score need only samples but do not directly enforce coverage. We close this gap by introducing a differentiable loss function based on the expected coverage probability, estimated from samples alone. It applies to any conditional generative model, with no need for tractable densities or architectural changes. We prove that it is a strict divergence, vanishing if and only if the model equals the true posterior. On simulation-based inference benchmarks, it matches a density-based coverage loss without evaluating the density. On high-dimensional imaging inverse problems, it yields better-calibrated posteriors than scoring-rule regularizers, with little change in the reconstruction quality of point estimates.
arxiv.comment: 32 pages, 7 figures
arxiv.titleZh: 用仅依赖样本的覆盖率损失训练校准的条件生成模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 条件生成模型常用于科学逆问题中从带噪间接测量采样后验，但往往过度自信，不确定性量化不可靠。已有正则化手段各有缺口:可微覆盖率目标需要模型密度且无法识别后验，能量分数等严格恰当评分规则只需样本却不直接约束覆盖率。作者提出基于期望覆盖概率的可微损失，仅用样本估计，适用于任意条件生成模型，无需可解密度或改动架构，并证明其为严格散度、当且仅当模型等于真实后验时为零。在基于仿真的推断基准上与基于密度的覆盖率损失持平，在高维成像逆问题中得到比评分规则正则化更校准的后验，点估计重建质量几乎不变。

arxiv.title: Large Payments Model
arxiv.abstract: Payment applications such as fraud detection, authorization prediction, and payment optimization draw on overlapping transaction information. This motivates a reusable payments intelligence layer that shares learned representations and predictive signals, rather than developing predictive models independently for each task. Realizing this shared capability requires handling heterogeneous transaction fields, high-cardinality identifiers, lifecycle-dependent attributes, long histories, and rare outcomes while meeting latency and cost constraints. We present Large Payments Model (LPM), a domain-specific foundation model designed for operational use and trained from scratch on large-scale structured transaction data to learn reusable representations for payment prediction tasks. LPM employs field-specific encodings and lifecycle-aware self-supervision in two complementary architectures: the Independent variant uses hybrid masking and supports efficient per-transaction inference, while the Sequence variant incorporates entity-linked histories through compact latent representations for richer temporal context. Optional distillation enables resource-constrained deployment. We pretrain LPM on up to 400 billion tokens and study scaling, downstream performance, and representation reuse. LPM improves over strong task-specific baselines across multiple prediction tasks in Merchant and Treasury Services, demonstrating applicability in distinct payment domains. Its representations also facilitate adaptation to a target not observed during pretraining through compact task-specific components. Together with production deployment, these results position LPM as a practical basis for reusable payments intelligence.
arxiv.titleZh: 大型支付模型（Large Payments Model）
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对欺诈检测、授权预测、支付优化等任务共享交易信息的特点，构建可复用的支付智能层：在超大规模结构化交易数据上从零预训练领域基础模型 LPM，采用字段专属编码与生命周期感知自监督，提供 Independent（混合掩码、支持单笔高效推理）与 Sequence（引入实体关联历史、紧凑隐表示）两种架构，并可选蒸馏以适配资源受限部署。预训练规模达 4000 亿 token，在商户服务与资金管理多条预测任务上优于强任务专用基线，且通过小型任务专用组件即可迁移到预训练阶段未见的目，并已投入生产部署。
arxiv.reason: 支付垂直领域基础模型，涉及大规模预训练与蒸馏，但不属 LLM 方向

arxiv.title: Sparse PCA with Overlapping Supports: NP-Hardness and an FPTAS
arxiv.abstract: In sparse principal component analysis (SPCA) with several components, each must be sparse and all must be pairwise orthogonal. When the supports of the components overlap, these two requirements interact. For a covariance matrix of fixed rank, polynomial-time algorithms with optimality or approximation guarantees are known for one component, and for several components with disjoint supports or with a common support. We study the general model, with individual sparsity constants and arbitrary support overlaps. We are given a rational $n\times r$ matrix $R$ and $d$ sparsity constants $s_i \le n$, and the goal is to find an $n\times d$ matrix $X$ with orthonormal columns that maximizes $\|R^\top X\|_F^2$, such that column $i$ has at most $s_i$ non-zero entries. Here $RR^\top$ plays the role of the covariance matrix and has rank at most $r$. We show that SPCA is NP-hard even when $r = d = 2$, but admits a fully polynomial-time approximation scheme (FPTAS) when $r$ and $d$ are fixed. The returned solution has exactly orthonormal columns, and its entries are real algebraic numbers in an exact representation. For fixed $ε$, the number of steps of the algorithm is linear in $n$ up to a polylogarithmic factor. Our approach reduces SPCA to a sparse version of the orthogonal Procrustes problem, that is, to maximizing a linear function over the feasible region of SPCA. We show that this problem is NP-hard even for $d = 2$, and we give an FPTAS for it when $d$ is fixed. This FPTAS combines approximate dynamic programming over the rows, two-column updates that restore exact orthogonality, and an exact computation of the few variables for which these updates are not available.
arxiv.titleZh: 带重叠支撑的稀疏 PCA：NP 难性与一个 FPTAS
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究多个主成分各自稀疏、两两正交且支撑集可重叠的一般稀疏 PCA 模型，目标是在秩至多 r 的协方差矩阵与逐列稀疏度 s_i 下最大化投影能量。证明该问题即使 r=d=2 也为 NP 难，但在 r、d 固定时存在 FPTAS。算法将问题归约为稀疏正交 Procrustes 问题，即在可行域上最大化线性函数；该子问题在 d=2 时亦为 NP 难，d 固定时结合按行近似动态规划、恢复精确正交性的双列更新以及对少数无法更新变量的精确计算得到 FPTAS。返回解具有严格正交列，元素以实代数数精确表示，固定 ε 时步数对 n 近似线性。
arxiv.reason: 稀疏 PCA 理论算法，与 LLM 关注方向无直接关联

arxiv.title: Computational Explanations of Semantic Universals
arxiv.abstract: Despite their differences, the languages of the world share many deep features when it comes to how they express meaning. These semantic universals are likely to reflect shared aspects of human cognitive, communicative, and social structure. Recent advances in cross-linguistic semantics and computational linguistics allow us to develop explanations of the sources of such properties. This Element presents a body of work doing just that: we explicate a framework for providing computational explanations of semantic universals and then describe several such explanations using principles of ease of learning and efficient communication. Empirical domains include quantifiers, color terms, modals, and indefinites. After providing these explanations, we provide a discussion of future directions for advancing the explanatory power of computational methods in semantic typology.
arxiv.comment: submitted to Cambridge Elements in Semantics
arxiv.titleZh: 语义普遍性的计算解释
arxiv.summaryZh: 世界各语言在意义表达上共享大量深层特征（语义普遍性），其来源可能在于人类认知、交际与社会结构的共性。该书建立一套计算解释框架，以易学性与高效交际为原则，对量词、颜色词、情态词与不定代词等经验领域给出解释，并讨论计算方法在语义类型学中提升解释力的未来方向。该书属综述性专著，不含新的模型实验。
arxiv.reason: 语言类型学与形式语义专著，与 LLM 方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Honesty Is a Race: Predicting When Verifiable-Reward RL Teaches a Model to Bluff
arxiv.abstract: Two rewards with the same expected payoff at the start of training can end a reinforcement-learning run in opposite places, with an honest model or one that bluffs. We study rewards that pay $b$ for a verdict that a checker cannot verify ("this program is correct") and $r$ for a certificate that it accepts (an input revealing a bug). To first order, a GRPO step makes the model more honest exactly when $\tilde{p}\,r/b>1+κ$. Here $\tilde{p}$ is the rate at which the checker accepts the model's certificates, weighted toward the items on which the model still gives both verdicts, and $κ$ is the pull of the items on which the unverifiable verdict is right. Both terms move during training. A checker raises $\tilde{p}$, so near the threshold honesty is a race, which a run just below the threshold can win and a run under a lottery (random pay with the same mean) cannot. The term $κ$ starts large and falls as the other items settle, so a run just above the threshold first dips toward bluffing, on code nearly to zero, before climbing back. Paying the honest verdict also pulls the other items toward it, which predicts a ceiling on the payoff ratio, above which the model gives the honest verdict where it is wrong. On propositional Datalog, two code models, and abstention on grade-school math, with $p$ the model's success rate before RL, no run above $pr/b=1$ ends collapsed, and runs under the checker can survive slightly below it. At $pr/b=3$, above the ceiling, both code models call about half of correct programs buggy. On depth-3 Datalog, training generously under the checker and then cutting the payoff keeps the model at least 67% honest in three seeds, at a ratio where the same model trained from the start falls to 4-15% and is at most 47% honest after 160 steps. On depth-2 Datalog, when honesty collapses, a linear probe fit before RL still reads the truth.
arxiv.comment: 34 pages, 10 figures
arxiv.titleZh: 诚实是一场竞赛：预测可验证奖励 RL 何时教模型虚张声势
arxiv.summaryZh: 训练初始期望收益相同的两种奖励，可能把 RL 运行带向诚实或虚张声势两个相反的终点。对「裁决付 b、可验证证书付 r」的奖励做一阶分析可得：一次 GRPO 更新令模型更诚实，当且仅当 p̃r/b>1+κ；其中 p̃ 为检查器接受证书的比率，κ 为不可验证裁决恰好正确的拉力。二者在训练中都会变化，因此阈值附近形成一场竞赛，等均值的随机抽奖则无法取胜。在命题 Datalog、两个代码模型与小学数学弃答上，pr/b>1 的运行均未崩溃，pr/b=3 时两个代码模型把约一半正确程序判为有 bug；深度 3 Datalog 上先宽松训练再削减收益，三个种子下仍至少 67% 诚实，从头训练仅 4–15%。
arxiv.reason: RLVR 奖励设计与诚实性机理分析，直接命中后训练方向

arxiv.title: From Link Prediction to Linear Community Detection: A Finite-Sample Guarantee for Graph Pretraining
arxiv.abstract: Link prediction (LP) is a standard pretraining objective for graph neural networks (GNNs): hide edges, train an encoder-decoder to predict them, and reuse the node embeddings for downstream node tasks. Despite its empirical success, there is little quantitative theory explaining why an edge-level objective should produce embeddings that are linearly useful for node classification. We study this question in the finite-sample stochastic block model (SBM). For any bounded GNN encoder paired with a symmetric bilinear decoder, we prove a conditional reduction: small population held-out LP excess risk implies small community-classification error for a transductive linear classifier on the learned embeddings. The bound decomposes into an optimization residual, an architectural approximation residual, and explicit statistical terms of order $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{d/n})$ in bounded dense regimes. We further give a constructive few-label classifier: nearest-centroid classification under the positive semidefinite quadratic form $G = W Z^\top Z W$, whose label error is coupled to LP quality. The framework is architecture-agnostic through the approximation residual, and we instantiate this residual as $O(\log n / n)$ for a graph isomorphism network (GIN) with spectral positional encoding and a bilinear decoder. Synthetic SBM experiments validate the theorem chain from LP risk to score error to classification error, and show when the worst-case constants become conservative.
arxiv.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 47 pages, 8 figures. Code: https://github.com/YChen1103/LP-to-Linear-Community-Detection
arxiv.titleZh: 从链接预测到线性社区检测：图预训练的有限样本保证
arxiv.summaryZh: 链接预测是图预训练的常用目标，但边级目标为何能产生对节点分类线性可用的嵌入，一直缺少定量理论。该工作在有限样本随机块模型下，对任意有界GNN编码器与对称双线性解码器证明条件归约：留出集链接预测的总体超额风险小，则所学嵌入上转导线性分类器的社区分类误差也小；该界分解为优化残差、架构逼近残差与Õ(√(d/n))统计项，并给出在WZᵀZW半正定二次型下做最近质心分类的少标签构造性分类器，其标签误差与链接预测质量耦合。对带谱位置编码的GIN与双线性解码器，逼近残差可实例化为O(log n/n)。合成SBM实验验证了从链接预测风险到得分误差再到分类误差的定理链，并显示最坏常数在何种情形下偏保守。
arxiv.reason: 图预训练理论保证，与LLM后训练及Agent方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
arxiv.abstract: System One models promise fast, general-purpose decision-making without lengthy token generation. However, understanding their capability spectrum and decision reliability requires more than aggregate performance on current benchmarks. Existing evaluations often provide limited insight into the breadth of model capabilities and the reliability of their decisions. We introduce SO-Arena, a benchmark characterizing the capability spectrum and decision reliability of System One models across 11 domains and five capability families. For the capability spectrum, SO-Arena offers evidence-grounded evaluation through reliable sources and manual verification of reference labels against model-visible inputs; fine-grained capability assessment through domain-specific difficulty criteria; and realistic interactive evaluation, where models iteratively execute actions in sandboxes. Reasoning-intensive tasks further enable system one-two comparison. Beyond accuracy, SO-Arena assesses decision reliability through two complementary measures: decision stability under controlled option-set changes and missing-answer recognition when no valid option is available. Evaluations across 21 models reveal that the benefits of scaling and additional reasoning vary substantially across domains. More importantly, strong overall performance does not necessarily imply reliable decision-making: the best-performing System One model ranks only seventh in reliability. Together, these findings highlight the need to characterize capability spectrum and decision reliability as complementary dimensions, providing a systematic view of the strengths and limitations of System One models.
arxiv.comment: 32 pages, 10 figures, 7 tables. Project page: https://lichenlillc.github.io/SO-Arena
arxiv.titleZh: SO-Arena:评测System One模型的能力谱系与决策可靠性
arxiv.summaryZh: SO-Arena基准面向不生成冗长思维链、快速决策的System One模型，刻画其能力谱系与决策可靠性:覆盖11个领域、五类能力，参考答案来自可核验来源并人工校验，采用领域相关难度标准，并让模型在沙盒中多轮交互执行，推理密集型任务可做系统一/系统二对比。可靠性用两项指标衡量:受控选项集变化下的决策稳定性，以及无有效选项时的缺失答案识别。评测21个模型显示，规模扩展与额外推理的收益随领域差异很大，总体表现最好的System One模型可靠性仅排第七，表明能力广度与决策可靠性需作为互补维度评估。
arxiv.reason: 系统一模型评测基准，覆盖能力谱系与决策可靠性，属评测方法学方向
